The W303 count agrees with the published figure of roughly 9500 differences from S288C, which is the main external check that the alignment and calling settings are right.

BY4742 is an S288C derivative and only about 40 called sites separate the two. The report warns whenever the top two strains are separated by fewer than 200 sites, because at that margin the probability depends on site errors being independent, which correlated error breaks.
k must stay well below the read length. The SRR26617475 run has 35 bp reads, where k=31 called 14 sites out of 35263 and k=21 called 34003 of 36694.
